meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 调用 Centinela(QA)代理做安全审计:检查 OWASP Top 10、硬编码密钥、依赖 CVE 和智能合约,报告写入 docs/reviews/,给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED 结论,不负责修复。
howto.when: 发布前、改动认证/授权或数据处理代码后、新增依赖时都可以用,也适合周期性安全复查;输入 /security-audit 触发,可指定目录范围。

say.note: 不写范围就审计整个 src/ 目录

say.text: 对 src/auth/ 做安全审计,附上给 Dev 的修复顺序
say.note: 报告含按严重程度分级的结论与修复顺序

howto.what_en: Runs a security audit via the Centinela (QA) agent: checks OWASP Top 10, hardcoded secrets, dependency CVEs and smart contracts, writes a report to docs/reviews/ with an APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED verdict, and never fixes issues.
howto.when_en: Use before a release, after changes to auth, authorization or data handling, when adding dependencies, or for periodic review. Trigger with /security-audit, optionally with a directory scope.

say_en.text: Audit src/auth/ for secrets and dependency CVEs
say_en.note: Report includes fix order for the Dev agent
